user_clarification: If one of the initially sampled demonstrations fails, continue sampling candidate 31, 32, 33, and so on until successful.
confirmed_interpretation: For every canonical seed, continue the same deterministic normalized-latent candidate stream. Treat every candidate as one atomic four-corner bundle; archive and reject the whole candidate if any corner fails; accept the whole candidate only if all four corners succeed; continue until exactly 30 bundles have been accepted.

candidate_order.phase_1: Continue the unprocessed records from the original active frozen-30 list in its exact frozen order.
candidate_order.phase_2: After all original frozen records are decided, continue at max(original_frozen_candidate_index)+1 in ascending candidate_index order.
candidate_order.skip_rule: Skip candidate indices already accepted or rejected in the composition ledger; do not revisit old Stage 2 rejected indices below the frozen-stream frontier.
candidate_order.termination: Stop immediately when 30 atomic four-corner bundles have been accepted for the canonical seed.

deterministic_candidate_stream.candidate_index: zero-based draw position in this stream
deterministic_candidate_stream.extension_beyond_159: Regenerate deterministically from index zero and continue the identical draw order for indices 160 and above.

pairing_change.analysis_requirement: Audit and report which accepted rows retain old-anchor latent pairing. Do not claim replacement rows are paired to the 25 immutable anchors.

implementation_gate: Implement deterministic candidate generation and verify all existing 0-159 source records exactly.
Test frozen-list continuation, extension ordering, whole-candidate atomic reject/accept, crash/resume idempotence, and exact 30-success termination.
Create collection_progress_v3.json without modifying v1 or v2 progress.
Freeze candidate_stream_v3.json and protocol_v3.json before submitting a v3 collection job.
Do not submit HDF5 or downstream jobs until all five seeds have exactly 30 accepted bundles and all 20 raw datasets strictly validate.
